CANONICAL_NAME.value: python-sgp4 2.23 -- Vallado's SGP4/SDP4 satellite propagator (C++ core + Python), with the official test vectors (Brandon Rhodes)

value.lineage: Simplified General Perturbations model 4 (Hoots & Roehrich, Spacetrack Report #3, 1980) as revised by Vallado, Crawford, Hujsak & Kelso (AIAA 2006-6753) -- the propagator behind every Two-Line Element set. Orbital mechanics under Earth oblateness, drag and lunar-solar resonance; the package embeds Vallado's C++ and ships tcppver.out, the reference trajectories every implementation must reproduce.

value.built_to: predict where a satellite will be from a compact element set, fast enough for thousands of objects, accurately enough to point an antenna
value.pressure: Earth oblateness, atmospheric drag, deep-space resonances; a legacy element format whose meaning is defined by this very algorithm
value.success_means: trajectories reproduce the reference vectors to the published tolerance

value.pressure: perturbations (drag, oblateness), precision, compatibility with a 1980 data format
value.failure_condition: a term or unit slip puts the predicted position kilometres off and the antenna misses
